settings.subtitle: Personal preferences for your account

settings.customConceptOptionsDescription: Extra values for the "Trade concept" field, alongside the fixed list — only visible in your own trade form.
settings.instrumentsDescription: The symbols you can pick when logging a trade in this journal (e.g. ES, NQ, AAPL, BTC). New values are stored in uppercase so your per-instrument analysis groups cleanly.
